# Here our knowledge stops

How sure we are: <span class="tag tag-hyp">HYPOTHESIS</span>

Everything above was observed on the phone. Three areas are only partly known. For each one the next pages say what has
been observed, what is guessed, and what experiment would settle it.

These pages describe experiments, not procedures. A step that writes to the phone's hardware is only run after a
written description of the address, the value, the current state and the way back, and an explicit decision.
